CBO: Local Python file coupling; import and explicit literal .py dependency; outbound distinct local project modules, mean over Q modules, NOT class-level CKJM.
Cohm: Within module, 10*R/P; class methods and @server.tool functions; related iff share self attribute or call same local imported helper; report Q, M, P, R per module; NA if no pair.
NLOC: Nonempty noncomment lines, including docstrings and decorators, exclusive layers separated from shared provider.
Ripple: Measured separately in validate_modularity_v4.py, five contract breaks on actual project copies; third gateway arm not mutation-tested.
design: 5 logical simulated clients, 10 deterministic mocks; structural metrics are single deterministic evaluations, not n=5 independent samples.
